example.name: Simple constructor
example.description:
The default constructor for a module can be overridden by registering a custom constructor. Its parameters are available as flags in the `dagger call` command directly.
:::important Dagger modules have only one constructors. Constructors of [custom types](./custom-types.mdx) are not registered; they are constructed by the function that [chains](./index.mdx#chaining) them. :::
